what: Weighted silhouette IoU of the Tradie Ute against its reference sheets (tools/vehicles/fit: side 0.4, top 0.3, front 0.15, rear 0.15). The Ute had no contact sheet before br-bwju.11, so 'before' is the br-bwju.8 bake scored against the new sheets (before-br-bwju.8/score-lod<N>.json, same evaluator, Playwright Chromium on eris); after = reference-lod<N>/score.json. tris as the fit page counts them (interior blocks included; the bake's own counts, interiors excluded, are 2080 / 878 / 596).
